name: approve_access_request
title: Approve access request
description: Give a waiting account access to the panel with a role, and optionally direct grants.

platform.description: The waiting account's login provider, from list_access_candidates

platformUserId.description: The waiting account's id at its provider, from list_access_candidates

roleId.description: Role ID from list_roles; left out, the default role

directGrants.description: Permission ids given on top of the role

name: archive_world
title: Archive world
description: Archive a stopped world: it keeps its backups and can be restored, but cannot start until then.

gameId.description: Game ID from get_control_plane, for example minecraft

name: build_release
title: Build release
description: Build a new release of a preset from its current definition, or retry a failed build. Building takes several minutes; follow it in get_control_plane.

gameId.description: Game ID from get_control_plane, for example minecraft

profileDigest.description: The preset definition's digest from get_control_plane, so a preset that changed meanwhile is refused

retryRelease.description: A failed release to build again

name: change_person_role
title: Change a person's role
description: Give a person another role. You cannot change your own role, nor remove the last Owner.

name: create_access_invitation
title: Invite a person to the panel
description: Create an invitation link to the panel, and send it by email when an address is given.

email.description: Where to send the link; left out, the link is only returned

name: create_role
title: Create role
description: Create a panel role with a set of permissions.

permissions.description: Permission ids from list_roles' catalogue; you can give only permissions you hold

name: create_world
title: Create world
description: Create a world from a preset on one of its built releases. It starts stopped; start it with start_world.

gameId.description: Game ID from get_control_plane, for example minecraft

displayName.description: The world's name, as players see it

release.description: A release version of the world's preset, from get_control_plane

placement.description: Where the world runs: the deployment's configured host, or a host launched for it

connectivity.description: How players reach it: the ZeroTier network, the host's public address, or a DNS name

auth.description: Who checks a player: the game's own accounts, or an external whitelist; needed unless connectivity is zerotier

name: delete_host
title: Delete a persistent host
description: Delete a stopped persistent host on which no world is placed, with its data volumes. Choose whether the data volumes are kept as snapshots first.

snapshot.description: Keep a snapshot of each data volume before it is deleted

name: delete_person
title: Delete person
description: Delete a person's identity and access, and remove their name from what they did.

name: delete_role
title: Delete role
description: Delete a role nobody holds and that is not the default.

version.description: The role's version from list_roles, so a role changed meanwhile is refused

name: dismiss_access_request
title: Dismiss access request
description: Dismiss a waiting account's request for access.

platform.description: The waiting account's login provider, from list_access_candidates

platformUserId.description: The waiting account's id at its provider, from list_access_candidates

name: get_backup_download_link
title: Get backup download link
description: Create a download link, valid for five minutes, for one backup archive of a world, named by its key from list_world_backups. Who asked is recorded.

gameId.description: Game ID from get_control_plane, for example minecraft

name: get_console_history
title: Get console history
description: Read a world's recent console commands, newest first, with who ran each and the game's answer.

gameId.description: Game ID from get_control_plane, for example minecraft

name: get_console_result
title: Get console result
description: Read the answer to one console command by the id send_console_command returned. Its status stays pending until the game answers.

gameId.description: Game ID from get_control_plane, for example minecraft

name: get_control_plane
title: Get Spawnpoint control plane
description: List games, worlds, sessions, hosts, releases, permissions, and their current state. Call this before a world action.

name: get_host_metrics
title: Get host metrics
description: Read recent metrics for one host shown by get_control_plane. Name it by hostId.

instanceId.description: The old name of hostId: give hostId instead

name: get_operation_progress
title: Get operation progress
description: Read how far a world's start, stop or other operation has come: its steps and the host's own lines.

gameId.description: Game ID from get_control_plane, for example minecraft

operationId.description: The operation's id, from get_control_plane or the call that started it

name: get_release
title: Get release
description: Read one release: its loader, runtime, source preset, server mods and, when players install a different set, the players' mods, each with its SHA-256 digest.

gameId.description: Game ID from get_control_plane, for example minecraft

version.description: Release version from get_control_plane, for example 1.2

name: get_release_diff
title: Compare releases
description: Read what a release changes: the mods and files added, removed or changed, against another release or the one its build compared it with.

gameId.description: Game ID from get_control_plane, for example minecraft

version.description: Release version from get_control_plane, for example 1.2

from.description: The release to compare with; left out, the one its build compared it with

name: get_release_mod_link
title: Get release mod link
description: Create a download link, valid for fifteen minutes, for one mod of a release, server or players', named by its SHA-256 digest from get_release.

gameId.description: Game ID from get_control_plane, for example minecraft

version.description: Release version from get_control_plane, for example 1.2

sha256.description: The mod's SHA-256 digest from get_release

name: get_release_pack_link
title: Get release pack link
description: Create a temporary download link for a release's server pack or full client pack.

gameId.description: Game ID from get_control_plane, for example minecraft

version.description: Release version from get_control_plane, for example 1.2

pack.description: Which pack: the server's files, or the full client pack

name: get_whitelist
title: Get whitelist
description: Read the players who may join a world: the names its record keeps, or the running server's own list.

gameId.description: Game ID from get_control_plane, for example minecraft

name: get_world_log_result
title: Get world log result
description: Read the lines of one log read by the id read_world_log returned. Its status stays pending until the host answers.

gameId.description: Game ID from get_control_plane, for example minecraft

name: get_world_metrics
title: Get world metrics
description: Read recent metrics for one world's session: players, tick time, memory and processor.

gameId.description: Game ID from get_control_plane, for example minecraft

name: get_world_pack
title: Get world client pack
description: Create a temporary download link for the client pack used by the world's active release.

gameId.description: Game ID from get_control_plane, for example minecraft

name: invite_players
title: Invite players
description: Send an invitation to play a world through the Telegram bot: to everyone, or to the people named.

gameId.description: Game ID from get_control_plane, for example minecraft

audience.description: Everyone the bot can reach, or only the people named

recipientIdentityIds.description: For direct: identity ids from list_invitation_recipients

name: list_access_candidates
title: List access requests
description: List the accounts waiting for access to the panel.

name: list_access_invitations
title: List access invitations
description: List the invitations to the panel that are still open.

name: list_config_files
title: List config files
description: List the config files a world may edit: the release's files and the world's own versions, with their digests.

gameId.description: Game ID from get_control_plane, for example minecraft

name: list_identities
title: List people
description: List the people with access to the panel, their roles, direct grants and linked accounts.

name: list_invitation_recipients
title: List invitation recipients
description: List the people a player invitation can go to directly, with whether the Telegram bot can reach each.

name: list_roles
title: List roles
description: List the panel's roles with their permissions, who holds each, the default role, and the catalogue of permissions.

name: list_world_backups
title: List world backups
description: List recoverable backups for one Spawnpoint world.

gameId.description: Game ID from get_control_plane, for example minecraft

name: list_world_invitations
title: List world invitations
description: List the invitations sent for a world, newest first.

gameId.description: Game ID from get_control_plane, for example minecraft

name: promote_world
title: Move world to a release
description: Move a world onto another built release of its preset, keeping its map. A running world is stopped, backed up and started again.

gameId.description: Game ID from get_control_plane, for example minecraft

name: purge_world
title: Delete world permanently
description: Delete an archived world and every backup of it, permanently.

gameId.description: Game ID from get_control_plane, for example minecraft

confirmation.description: The world's id again, to confirm

name: read_config_file
title: Read config file
description: Read one config file as the world's next start will write it, with its SHA-256 digest.

gameId.description: Game ID from get_control_plane, for example minecraft

path.description: The file's path from list_config_files, for example config/claims.toml

name: read_world_log
title: Read world log
description: Ask a running world's host for the game's recent log, about its last 200 lines. Returns the read's id; read the lines with get_world_log_result. Addresses, ids and player names are replaced by tokens.

gameId.description: Game ID from get_control_plane, for example minecraft

name: reset_config_file
title: Reset config file
description: Drop the world's own version of a config file, so the next start takes the release's file.

gameId.description: Game ID from get_control_plane, for example minecraft

path.description: The file's path from list_config_files, for example config/claims.toml

expected.description: The world's version's digest from list_config_files

name: restore_backup
title: Restore backup
description: Restore one of a world's backups, which opens a new wipe from it. The current map is backed up first.

gameId.description: Game ID from get_control_plane, for example minecraft

name: retire_release
title: Retire release
description: Retire a release so no world can move onto it, and remove its files once no world uses it.

gameId.description: Game ID from get_control_plane, for example minecraft

version.description: Release version from get_control_plane, for example 1.2

name: revoke_access_invitation
title: Revoke access invitation
description: Revoke an open invitation to the panel, so its link no longer works.

name: save_config_file
title: Save config file
description: Save the whole text of one config file as the world's own version. It applies at the world's next start.

gameId.description: Game ID from get_control_plane, for example minecraft

path.description: The file's path from list_config_files, for example config/claims.toml

expectedSha256.description: The digest read_config_file returned, so a file changed meanwhile is refused; null for a new file

name: send_console_command
title: Send console command
description: Send one console command to a running world, as the connected person. Commands that stop the game outside its lifecycle are refused. The command is recorded with the person's and this client's names. Returns the command's id; read its answer with get_console_result.

gameId.description: Game ID from get_control_plane, for example minecraft

command.description: One line, as typed in the game's console

name: set_default_role
title: Set default role
description: Choose the role every newly approved person gets.

name: set_whitelist
title: Set whitelist
description: Replace a world's whitelist with this whole list of names. A running world reloads it at once.

gameId.description: Game ID from get_control_plane, for example minecraft

names.description: Every player name that may join, as the players type them

name: start_world
title: Start world
description: Request that Spawnpoint start one world. The returned operation is asynchronous; poll get_control_plane for completion.

gameId.description: Game ID from get_control_plane, for example minecraft

name: stop_world
title: Stop world
description: Request a verified backup and stop for one world. The returned operation is asynchronous; poll get_control_plane for completion.

gameId.description: Game ID from get_control_plane, for example minecraft

players.description: With players online: refuse to stop (the default), or disconnect them

name: update_game_settings
title: Change game settings
description: Set a world's game settings, such as difficulty or the player limit, by the setting ids get_control_plane lists for its game. They apply at the next start.

gameId.description: Game ID from get_control_plane, for example minecraft

values.description: Setting id to value; a setting left out keeps its default

name: update_role
title: Change role
description: Change a role's name, description and permissions. Everyone holding it is affected at once.

version.description: The role's version from list_roles, so a role changed meanwhile is refused

permissions.description: Permission ids from list_roles' catalogue; you can give only permissions you hold

name: update_world_settings
title: Change world hosting
description: Change where a stopped world runs and how players reach it. Refused while the world runs.

gameId.description: Game ID from get_control_plane, for example minecraft

placement.description: Where the world runs: the deployment's configured host, or a host launched for it

connectivity.description: How players reach it: the ZeroTier network, the host's public address, or a DNS name

auth.description: Who checks a player: the game's own accounts, or an external whitelist; needed unless connectivity is zerotier

warm.description: Keep its launched host stopped, not destroyed, between sessions (fleet only)

market.description: Launch its host on Spot where its game allows, or always On-Demand (fleet only)

name: wipe_world
title: Wipe world
description: Start a new wipe of a world on a release: the current map is backed up and closed, and the next start makes a new one.

gameId.description: Game ID from get_control_plane, for example minecraft

release.description: A release version of the world's preset, from get_control_plane
